description.zh: 在日落最後一束光消失前，海岸線像一段仍未完成的電影。
description.en: Before the final light disappears, the coastline feels like an unfinished film.

direction.zh: 低角度廣角、暖冷對比、大片留白
direction.en: Low-angle wide frame, warm-cool contrast, generous negative space

description.zh: 山脈沉入夜色，天空留下柔和而不真實的光。
description.en: Mountains sink into night while the sky holds an unreal, gentle light.

direction.zh: 遠景分層、冷色夜空、中央引導線
direction.en: Layered distance, cool night sky, central leading line

description.zh: 森林不是黑色，而是由月光切開的無數深藍層次。
description.en: The forest is not black, but many layers of blue cut open by moonlight.

direction.zh: 垂直樹群、低照度、銀藍反射
direction.en: Vertical tree rhythm, low-key light, silver-blue reflections

description.zh: 雨水把城市的燈光重新混色，屋頂成為安靜的觀景台。
description.en: Rain remixes the city lights, turning the rooftop into a silent observatory.

direction.zh: 深景深、濕地反光、非對稱構圖
direction.en: Deep perspective, wet reflections, asymmetrical composition

description.zh: 失重的島嶼在雲層之上生長，像一座沒有入口的花園。
description.en: Weightless islands grow above the clouds like a garden with no entrance.

direction.zh: 多層空間、柔霧、視線向上
direction.en: Layered space, soft mist, upward visual movement

description.zh: 暮色讓湖面與山脈共享同一種呼吸。
description.en: Blue hour lets the lake and mountains share the same breath.

direction.zh: 水平構圖、鏡面反射、低飽和藍調
direction.en: Horizontal framing, mirror reflection, restrained blue palette

description.zh: 遠方行星的環穿過太空站視窗，像一條沉默的地平線。
description.en: A distant planet's ring crosses the station window like a silent horizon.

direction.zh: 廣角室內、巨物尺度、冷灰金屬
direction.en: Wide interior, monumental scale, cool metallic palette

description.zh: 研究站在沙塵與暮光之間保持微弱訊號。
description.en: A research outpost keeps a faint signal alive between dust and dusk.

direction.zh: 低矮建築、荒漠留白、暖灰色階
direction.en: Low architecture, desert negative space, warm gray scale

description.zh: 清晨的湖邊村落用微風和薄霧慢慢醒來。
description.en: A lakeside village wakes slowly through breeze and morning mist.

direction.zh: 柔光、低對比、生活化遠景
direction.en: Soft light, low contrast, lived-in distant view

description.zh: 透明結構把光拆成安靜而精準的色塊。
description.en: Transparent structures split light into quiet, precise fields of color.

direction.zh: 中心構圖、折射材質、受控色彩
direction.en: Centered composition, refractive material, controlled color
